paragraphs.text: The Myojin of Cleansing Fire is the Myojin kami of white magic on Kamigawa .
The Myojin of Cleansing Fire embodies the force of purification and white Magic. It is not known how it is related to the Myojin of Blooming Dawn which also represents an aspect of white magic.

A shrine to the Myojin of Cleansing Fire was present in Takeshi Konda 's inner chambers the night that Kyodai was taken. Pearl-Ear observed the Myojin crying actual tears that night, and they sizzled like lava as they fell softly to the floor beneath the shrine.
During the Kami War , it turned against mortals like the rest of the Kami.
